newsitem.title: POLAND: Polifarb C 1996 net seen at PLN 18 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polifarb C 1996 net seen at PLN 18 mln.

text.p: Polish paintmaker Polifarb Cieszyn SA should raise its net profit to 18 million zlotys this year and to 25.8 million zlotys in 1997 from 15.3 million zlotys last year, IB Austria Securities said in a report.
The report was dated August 1 and released to the press on Monday. In that period Polfarb Cieszyn rose on the Warsaw bourse to 13 zlotys from 10.8 zlotys per share.
IB Austria saw Polifarb's sales rising to 317 million zlotys this year and to 400 million zlotys in 1997 from 261 million zlotys last year.
"Polifarb Cieszyn is the leader in the paint and lacquer sector in Poland... (and) has all the numbers for a further intensification of its development," the report said.
Polifarb currently produces 27 percent of Poland's paint and has a 20-percent market share.
It said the firm would likely benefit from a turnaround in the residential construction industry and in the longer term would lift sales in the auto, metal and anti-corrosion industries.
It saw increased demand from Daewoo's and GM's car building activities in Poland.
